impeller|ASSET-017.text:
The impeller is a rotating vaned wheel that adds energy to the liquid and helps set the pump’s head-flow curve; this is general training knowledge from an illustrative, non-OEM source [KB-XRAY-PUMP#impeller].

Evidence it may be faulty is a fouling/efficiency-loss signature on the pump asset: current condition is “attention_required,” issue code “FOULING,” and the recommended next check is to inspect the hydraulic path [DOC-ASSET-017]. Supporting events repeatedly mention “efficiency loss / fouling-like signature” [EVT-00037][EVT-00375][EVT-00248]. Typical impeller-related symptoms in the training source include fouling on vanes causing lower flow for the same power, cavitation erosion, and imbalance with vibration at 1× running speed [KB-XRAY-PUMP#impeller].
